summary: Archer Aviation filed an 8-K to disclose a prospectus supplement for the resale of 3,266,870 Class A common shares issued to selling stockholders under stock purchase agreements dated May 13, 2026, and the issuance of up to $8 million of vendor shares for services/goods. The resale shares were registered on Form S-3 (333-284812). Fenwick & West LLP provided legal opinions on validity. This is a routine shelf-takedown and share issuance for working capital and vendor payments, not a strategic event or special situation.
